message: 変態は誰だ!?

name: Arden
message: 「Daaaaaaaaah! The great me is defeateddddd...」
With a massive boom, Arden's huge body went flying and crashed onto the ground with a rumbling thud.

name: Synn
message: 「We won...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huff, huff, huff... I'm completely exhausted...」

name: Misa
message: 「He was an idiot, but he was strong...」

name: Ria
message: 「The old you all wouldn't have been able to win. You've gotten really strong.」

name: Sally
message: 「Na-na, na-na, scaredy-cat caterpillar~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's take this opportunity to rename you Lolotte Bear, okay?」

name: Pasta
message: 「So uncool, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「Sorry... Pasta-chan, sorry... I couldn't beat those perverts... The great me is way too uncool... Waaah, waaah, waaah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. He's crying...」

name: Arden
message: 「I ain't crying... Just got some dust in my eye...」

name: Arden
message: 「Don't take a picture!」
Arden slowly stood up.

name: Arden
message: 「Damn it... Even though you guys are this strong... ganging up on frail, delicate, tiny little Pasta-chan to bully her is the lowest of the low...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Frail... really?」

name: Misa
message: 「Not at all. She's the very definition of tyrannical.」

name: Pasta
message: 「What rude jerks, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「You brute bastards! You're a disgrace to humanity!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if a demon tells us that...」

name: Arden
message: 「Come to think of it, fair point. Hahaha. You got me there!」
He's an idiot, but he doesn't seem like a bad person.

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, we weren't bullying her.」

name: Arden
message: 「Whaaat!」

name: Arden
message: 「You guys hid Pasta-chan's indoor shoes, sniffed them, secretly licked her recorder, put stolen bloomers on your heads (and so on)」

name: Synn
message: 「We did not!」

name: Misa
message: 「And what's with that level of perversion? Even Sakura-kun wouldn't cast his net that wide.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you did wear school swimsuits and lick recorders, then. Though I fail to see what is enjoyable about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「We didn't do it on a narrow scale either.」

name: Arden
message: 「Pasta-chan! What's going on here?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「These guys are definitely Pasta's enemies, nya, but they're not perverts like that, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「Then why the hell did you ask me for help?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Well, that's...」

name: Arden
message: 「Nukufuu.」

name: Arden
message: 「D-Damn it. Was it Bylous?! That bastard!」

name: Pasta
message: 「...P-Pasta was in the wrong too, nya.」

name: Arden
message: 「I got played! Damn it. Bylous and that female teacher who fed me all those lies! I won't forgive 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「He left...」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's go after him!」

name: Ria
message: 「I have a feeling he won't be coming back, though. Going by his personality.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did he mean at the end about getting tricked by a female teacher?」

name: Synn
message: 「Who knows...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Both the President and the Treasurer are quite ignorant. A female teacher refers to a woman employed in the teaching profession.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think that's the issue here.」

name: Bylous
message: 「So Arden was no match for them.」

name: Azel
message: 「You look like you're having fun.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Knowing that man, I was just imagining how pathetic a spectacle he must have made.」

name: Soltia
message: 「To me, it looks like you're happy that the Student Council is getting stronger.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I wonder about that?」

name: Soltia
message: 「If we leave them alone, they'll become wolves.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Are you saying we should prioritize wiping out the Student Council?」

name: Soltia
message: 「It's obvious they'll become a major threat by the time of the Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「No way. They're mere humans. Short-lived and fragile--」

name: Soltia
message: 「Precisely because they're short-lived.」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Precisely because they're short-lived, they grow rapidly. The steep spike in their growth curve, calculated from our battles so far, is terrifying.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I see. So we'll have to deal with both the Student Council and the enemy hiding behind them.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Which is exactly why--」

name: Bylous
message: 「Which is exactly why my opinion is that we can't do anything right now.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Can't the three of us just attack at the same time? If one fights the Student Council while the other two stay on guard, we can handle whatever shows up.」

name: Bylous
message: 「...Hmph.」
Bylous looked equally at Azel and Soltia.

name: Bylous
message: 「Do you really think we can do that?」

name: Soltia
message: 「You're right. It's impossible for us.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Soltia
message: 「You hesitated to answer, so you already know, don't you?」
The park was enveloped in complete silence.
